description_en: Modifies the SSL link configuration of an ApsaraDB RDS instance
description_zh: 该接口用于修改RDS实例的SSL链路配置
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-db-instance-ssl --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --connection-string rm-uf6wjk50000.mysql.rds.aliyuncs.com --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyDBInstanceSSL

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call DescribeDBInstances to obtain the instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The internal or public endpoint for which you want to create or update the server certificate
parameters.help_zh: 需要创建或更新服务器证书的内网或外网连接地址
parameters.name: connection_string

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable or disable SSL. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
开启或关闭SSL，取值：
1：开启
0：关闭
parameters.name: ssl_enabled

parameters.help_en:
The certificate type for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks. Valid values:
aliyun (default): uses an Alibaba Cloud certificate.
custom: uses a custom certificate.
This parameter is required when SSLEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL和PostgreSQL云盘版实例的证书类型，取值：
aliyun（默认值）：使用阿里云证书
custom：使用自定义证书
SSLEnabled为1时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: ca_type

parameters.help_en: The custom certificate content of the server for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL和PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器自定义证书内容。

CAType为custom时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_cert

parameters.help_en: The private key of the server certificate for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL和PostgreSQL云盘版实例的服务器证书私钥。

CAType为custom时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: server_key

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the public key of the client certificate authority (CA) for the ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例是否启用客户端授权机构公钥，取值：
1：启用
0：关闭
parameters.name: client_ca_enabled

parameters.help_en: The client certificate authorization public key for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端证书授权机构公钥。

ClientCAEbabled为1时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: client_ca_cert

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the client certificate revocation list (CRL) for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
1: Enabled.
0: Disabled.

This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例是否启用客户端吊销证书，取值：
1：启用
0：关闭

仅当ClientCAEnabled为1时，才允许配置
parameters.name: client_crl_enabled

parameters.help_en: The client revocation certificate file for ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instances with cloud disks
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的客户端吊销证书文件。

ClientCrlEnabled为1时，此参数必须配置
parameters.name: client_cert_revocation_list

parameters.help_en:
The authentication method for an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported for RDS PostgreSQL 12 and later)

This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的认证方法取值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）

仅当ClientCAEnabled为1时，才允许配置
parameters.name: acl

parameters.help_en:
The authentication method for the replication permission of an ApsaraDB RDS for PostgreSQL instance with cloud disks. Valid values:
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full (supported by RDS PostgreSQL 12 and later)
This parameter can be configured only when ClientCAEnabled is set to 1
parameters.help_zh:
PostgreSQL云盘版实例的replication权限认证方法，取值：
cert
prefer
verify-ca
verify-full（RDS PostgreSQL 12以上支持）
仅当ClientCAEnabled为1时，才允许配置
parameters.name: replication_acl

parameters.help_en: The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html for ApsaraDB RDS for MySQL and ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. Valid values:
parameters.help_zh:
MySQL、SQL Server实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html，取值：

1：开启。
0：未开启
parameters.name: force_encryption

parameters.help_en: The https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances. Connections using a version lower than the specified version are rejected. Currently supported values: 1.0, 1.1, and 1.2
parameters.help_zh:
指定SQL Server实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/95715.html，低于该版本将被拒绝连接。当前支持1.0、1.1、1.2。

例如：选择1.1表示服务端仅接受TLS 1.1和1.2协议版本的客户端连接请求，通过TLS 1.0建立连接的客户端会被拒绝连接
parameters.name: tls_version

parameters.help_en:
The custom certificate content for the SQL Server instance. Only the `pfx` certificate format is supported.
Public endpoint: `oss-<region ID>.aliyuncs.com:<Bucket name>:<certificate file name (with file extension)>`
Internal endpoint: `oss-<region ID>-internal.aliyuncs.com:<Bucket name>:<certificate file name (with file extension)>`
parameters.help_zh:
SQL Server实例的用户自定义证书内容，证书格式仅支持`pfx`。
公网地址：`oss-<地域ID>.aliyuncs.com:<Bucket名称>:<证书文件名称（带文件后缀）>`
内网地址：`oss-<地域ID>-internal.aliyuncs.com:<Bucket名称>:<证书文件名称（带文件后缀）>`
parameters.name: certificate

parameters.help_en: The password of the custom certificate for ApsaraDB RDS for SQL Server instances
parameters.help_zh: SQL Server实例的用户自定义证书密码
parameters.name: pass_word
